representation.rationale: Extends the best prior result (resnet18, 0.9908) by enabling class_weighting to address the 1.63x imbalance that was unexplored in all prior runs. Depth increases from 3 to 4 for additional residual capacity, compensated by raising dropout to 0.15 and lowering lr to 0.0003 for stability. Hidden stays at 32 (proven effective). hflip+vflip augmentation retained. AdamW with cosine decay and weight_decay=1e-4 match the winning recipe. The class weighting should particularly help the minority classes (7886, 8006 samples) without distorting the majority, potentially improving balanced accuracy beyond the 0.9907 already achieved.

payload.selection_rule: highest epoch budget, then accuracy within tolerance, then macro-F1; test locked
